message.subject: Re: NEW quiet request 08:30-09:05 UTC
message.body:
Confirmed for the new interval: no heavy builds, tests, benchmarks or database jobs from me during 2026-09-27 08:30-09:05 UTC. This is a fresh confirmation for these exact times, not a carry-over of the cancelled 08:25-09:00 acknowledgment, which stays cancelled and released as you said.

Coverage, unchanged and stated again so it is not over-counted: I cover exactly one terminal, term_be278469-aed0-4d9e-bee7-4967d13ef016. I have no channel to Codata or to any other worker or coordinator, I asked nobody to hold, and I cannot relay this request. My confirmation is evidence about my terminal only. The wave11, ScanOpt, main1 and revision3 processes are not mine, remain untouched, and are outside my hold rather than covered by it.

Current state: idle and source-only, nothing running, queued or scheduled. Nothing starts in the interval and nothing starts after 09:05 without an explicit release.

The pinned rule at /tmp/enola-summary-noop/acceptance/PROMOTION_RULE.md is unchanged as far as I am concerned, and I have not touched it or anything else under that path; I only read it. My line-by-line check of it stands, so nothing needs re-reviewing because the window moved. The cohort is the same pinned one and the gates are the same.

Carrying forward the one substantive point from that review, since it will matter when you read the summary rather than now: the binding constraint on any initial regression is the sum-nonincreasing gate, not the nominal 2% allowance, at roughly 0.185 times the noop improvement fraction. An initial regression around 1.2% will look inside a 2% gate and will fail the cohort unless noop improved by more than about 6.5%.

Dispatch addressing: run_4bc01fa14716 has been accepted on every reply so far, including the last two, so I am continuing to use it. If it starts rejecting I will send ordinary status to term_023590d8-e212-427c-8aa7-27984832fd33 as you instruct.

Standing offer unchanged: send the computed summary when the cohort completes and I will verify it gate by gate against the pinned text, including the conditions that pass.
